title: Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission-Ghaziabad celebrates the Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav, 76thIndependence Day of India.
bodyHtml:
Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission-Ghaziabad celebrates the Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav, 76thIndependence Day of India. It was attended by the staff of Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission. Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director hoisted the National flag and addressed the gathering on this proud moment.

Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission hoisted the flag on 76th Independence Day

Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, addressing the gathering on the occasion of 76th Independence Day.
